records.text: The Solid Oak viewer account wrote that when a cover-up loses momentum and fades from public memory, people involved typically start to mysteriously disappear.
records.speaker: Handle Solid Oak (identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: Solid oak rights, by keeping the case alive and thriving, you are keeping them alive as well. Once a cover-up starts to lose momentum and has faded from public memory, that is typically when those involved start to mysteriously disappear.
